name: Velvetwing

primary.name: Threaded Needles
primary.description: Two silk needles converge ahead of you, then cross and spread apart. 12 damage per needle; 440 reach.

secondary.name: Silk Tripline
secondary.description: Weave three silk lines ahead of you. They arm after 0.6s and last 4s. A crossing enemy snaps a line for 22 damage and a 2s slow. Each enemy is caught once per cast.

special.name: Lunar Loom
special.description: Two luminous wings sweep out and meet, linger for 1 second in a 60-unit field (6 damage each 0.25s), then split and return to you. Outward and returning passes each hit once for 18 damage. Walls block damage.

passive: Soft Landing: Silk Tripline surrounds you with a faint orb and grants 15% damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. Enemies that melee-hit you during this protection are poisoned for 2 damage every 0.5 seconds for 3 seconds.

technique.name: Patient Silk
technique.description: Silk Tripline lasts 50% longer, dealing 20% less snap damage.

final_technique.name: Silken Scythes
final_technique.description: Two short silk sweeps replace the needles. Hit each enemy once for 22; close-range coverage at the cost of ranged safety.

attack.name: Silken Scythes
attack.description: Two short silk sweeps replace the needles. Hit each enemy once for 22; close-range coverage at the cost of ranged safety.
